column1: # Performance and reliability gates (SRS §16: WSOS-PRF-001…006, REL-001/002; ARM-007 keeps separate ARM rows).
# profile          metric                        op  limit   need      requirement
# hw-*: reference hardware, the SRS numbers. ci-*-tcg: GitHub-hosted QEMU without KVM (software CPU emulation,
# roughly 5-10x slower), so time limits are wide: they catch regressions, they do not certify PRF numbers.
# need=required fails the gate when the metric is missing; optional only checks it when reported.
ci-amd64-tcg       boot_to_greeter_s             <=  600     required  WSOS-PRF-001 (CI regression bound)
ci-amd64-tcg       idle_cpu_pct                  <   25      required  WSOS-PRF-004 (CI regression bound)
ci-amd64-tcg       shell_ready_ms                <=  60000   optional  WSOS-PRF-002 (CI regression bound)
ci-arm64-tcg       boot_to_greeter_s             <=  1500    required  WSOS-ARM-007 (CI regression bound)
ci-arm64-tcg       idle_cpu_pct                  <   40      required  WSOS-ARM-007 (CI regression bound)
ci-arm64-tcg       shell_ready_ms                <=  120000  optional  WSOS-ARM-007 (CI regression bound)
